newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's Sodra Cell to limit pulp output - agency.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's Sodra Cell to limit pulp output - agency.

text.p: Swedish forestry company Sodra Cell plans to halt some of its pulp production for a three week period in March, Swedish news agency TT said on Wednesday.
Since last autumn the pulp industry has tried to push pulp prices over $560 a tonne but without success. Instead prices have in recent weeks fallen further to $550 a tonne.
In response to the price pressure, Sodra Cell, a unit of forestry cooperative Sodra, planned to limit output.
"We estimate we will reduced production to 85 percent of capacity this year," TT quoted Hans Burmeister, marketing director for Sodra Cell, as saying.
He said there was no firm decision yet on exactly when the pulp works will be stopped.
Sodra has invested 4.5 billion crowns in three pulp works in Monsteras, Morrum and Varo, taking annual capacity to 1.3 million tonnes of pulp.
